import sys

MOD = 1_000_000_007

def main():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    n = len(s)
    if n == 0:
        print(0)
        return

    # next_pos[i][c] = smallest index >= i where char c appears, else n
    next_pos = [[n] * 26 for _ in range(n + 1)]
    for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
        next_pos[i] = next_pos[i + 1][:]
        next_pos[i][ord(s[i]) - 97] = i

    # prev_pos[i][c] = largest index <= i where char c appears, else -1
    prev_pos = [[-1] * 26 for _ in range(n)]
    last = [-1] * 26
    for i in range(n):
        last[ord(s[i]) - 97] = i
        prev_pos[i] = last[:]

    # dp[l][r] = number of distinct palindromic subsequences in s[l..r]
    dp = [[0] * n for _ in range(n)]

    for length in range(1, n + 1):
        for l in range(n - length + 1):
            r = l + length - 1
            total = 0
            for c in range(26):
                i = next_pos[l][c]
                if i > r:
                    continue
                j = prev_pos[r][c]
                # palindrome consisting of only this character
                total += 1
                if i < j:
                    # wrap any palindrome inside s[i+1..j-1] with this char,
                    # plus the 2-letter palindrome cc
                    total += 1
                    if i + 1 <= j - 1:
                        total += dp[i + 1][j - 1]
            dp[l][r] = total % MOD

    print(dp[0][n - 1] % MOD)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
